target: continuous CWC Alipingal gauge level exactly 24 hours after issue time
threshold_screen: retained values 0–13.11 m (CWC listed historical HFL); excluded readings require source QC and are not treated as labels
reason: Diagnostic sample is small and covers only a near-constant low-stage regime; not suitable as a deployed forecast.
timestamp_timezone: not specified by source; naive wall-clock timestamps retained
method: duplicate timestamps median-collapsed; exact hourly lag availability required; one issue per midnight per day; target t+24h; split by calendar year; Ridge standardized using training data only; persistence predicts current level
